content.title: Why ZYRA is different from swipe culture
content.pillar: Why ZYRA is different from dating apps
content.objective: Explain the marriage-first Journey model without attacking members of other platforms.
content.hook: A Muslim marriage app should help a connection move somewhere meaningful.
content.body: ZYRA is being built around thoughtful discovery, compatibility that starts better conversations, a structured Journey and family support at the right moments. It is in private testing.
content.caption: A clearer path to marriage. ZYRA is currently in private testing.

content.title: What a Guardian can—and cannot—see
content.objective: Show that Guardian involvement has a real role and real privacy boundaries.
content.hook: Family support should not mean giving somebody unrestricted access to your account.
content.body: A ZYRA Guardian has their own account and follows only the Journeys their role and permissions allow. Private compatibility answers and unrelated Journeys stay private. ZYRA is in private testing.
content.caption: A real role. Clear boundaries. Private testing continues.
content.cta: Learn how Guardians fit into ZYRA.

content.title: Founder build diary: private testing
content.objective: Build trust by showing the product is being tested carefully before launch.
content.hook: Before ZYRA launches, I want the difficult parts tested—not hidden.
content.body: A short Founder update showing one real product improvement, what was learned and what remains private testing. No launch-date promise and no test-member data.
content.caption: Building ZYRA carefully. Still in private testing.
